findings.message: Large whitespace padding was detected (a block of blank lines or a long run of spaces). findings.remediation: Remove the large whitespace padding (blank-line blocks or long space runs) and review any content hidden below or to the right of it. Keep skill files compact and reviewable so no instructions can be concealed off-screen.
